result.title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Poster). 31 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch
result.summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliable application to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results naturally lead to ZO-BOLT, which applies ZO optimization to BOLT's RLVR-aligned weighted-SFT objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three model variants and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从方差理论角度分析零阶（ZO）优化中梯度估计的可靠性，指出两个有限差分评估是否基于同一批数据会导致不匹配数据情形下的 $1/\mu^2$ 噪声放大；据此提出 ZO-BOLT，将 ZO 用于与 RLVR 对齐的加权 SFT 目标，在保持近推理显存占用的同时提升数学推理表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于纯文本推理模型的训练端优化工作，其「数据匹配可抵消估计噪声」的结论可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹级监督与贡献分配中的方差控制线索，但与视觉证据、latent 状态表示本身无直接关系。
